body:
three taps and it knows. here they are, literally.

one: open longlivets.com and hit the sparkle icon at the top — third in the little row, next to the layers.

two: pick a starter chip, or ignore them and type your own sentence in the box. "however you want to say it" is not a figure of speech; a fragment works, so does a paragraph.

three: read what comes back. five songs, each with one line on why it fits, and a play button on every one.

that’s the whole thing. no account, no email, and the small print is real — what you type isn’t saved.
